test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held on: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Study the given pie-chart and answer the question that follows.

The pie-chart shows the expenditure incurred in the preparation of a book by a publisher, under various heads.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbeb9c2503681df26831f9f74d7cedeffb629577fcfb8d1b43fdedbff2ba52f9.png] 

What is the difference between the angle of pie-chart showing the expenditure incurred on binding and printing?
solution:
Given:

Expenditure incurred on binding = 30%

Expenditure incurred on printing = 25%

Calculation:

From the pie chart,

Total expenses = 100%

Total Central angle of circle = 360°

⇒ 100% → 360°

The difference between the angle of the pie-chart showing the expenditure incurred on binding and printing = 30 - 25 = 5%

⇒ 5% ≡ (360/100) × 5 = 18° 

∴ The central angle corresponding to the** difference between the angle of pie-chart showing the expenditure incurred on binding and printing is 18°.**
